import pytest
from rich.text import Text

def test_from_ansi_trailing_newline():
    """
    Test that Text.from_ansi() does not remove a trailing newline.
    """
    # The bug report states: Text("\n") != Text.from_ansi("\n")
    # And the expected output for "text\n" is <text 'text\n' [] ''>
    # So, we assert that Text.from_ansi("text\n") is equal to Text("text\n")
    assert Text.from_ansi("text\n") == Text("text\n")
